remaining_risks: Advisory only: a runner that ignores the session-start advisory is not stopped, and a session already running does not see a later pause request.
On a pause request the external gate appends an acknowledgement to ~/.dispatch-desk/ledger.jsonl (or $DISPATCH_DESK_LEDGER), outside this repository.
DISPATCH_DESK_HOME selects Python source that is executed (with -I, list argv). The override and the selected directory are trusted inputs; no provenance check.
Session start can wait up to 2.0 s for the git lookup and 2.0 s for the gate when the gate is installed; end-to-end latency was not measured.
Other test modules that exercise SessionStart are not isolated from a real gate by this change; static review found no path that reaches it, but that was not executed evidence.
by is always native-hook: the dispatcher cannot tell Claude Code from Codex, so acknowledgements do not distinguish them.
No live proof: no real session was run against a real pause request.
